user.description: Connect a Discord bot that watches your washer and posts one self-updating message per load. The README explains how to create the bot and find the channel ID.

data_description.bot_token: From the Bot tab of your application in the Discord Developer Portal.
data_description.channel_id: Numeric ID of the channel to post in. With Developer Mode on, right-click the channel and choose Copy ID.
data_description.running_entity: Binary sensor that is on while the washer runs.
data_description.job_state_entity: Reports the wash phase (wash, rinse, spin, drying, finish).
data_description.eta_entity: Timestamp of the washer's own estimated finish.
data_description.machine_state_entity: Reports run, pause or stop. Used for the paused display and to notice a load stopped on the machine.
data_description.energy_entity: Cumulative energy meter in kWh. Confirms loads and reports usage on the done message. Defaults to sensor.washer_energy.
data_description.water_entity: Optional. Cumulative water meter, reported on the done message.
data_description.wrinkle_entity: Optional. Binary sensor that is on during wrinkle-prevent tumbling, so it isn't mistaken for a load.
data_description.eta_interval: How often the live card's ETA and progress are refreshed.
data_description.ping_claimant_on_complete: Mention whoever claimed the load when it finishes.

error.invalid_channel: Channel ID must be all digits.

abort.already_configured: This Discord channel is already configured.

init.description: Detection timings and house-wide features. Saving reloads the integration, which briefly reconnects the bot.

data.learn_habits: Learn the days each person washes

data_description.eta_interval: How often the live card's ETA and progress are refreshed.
data_description.confirm_delay: How long a washer state change must hold before the bot acts on it. Filters out cloud flaps.
data_description.energy_idle: Offline backstop: end a load once the energy meter has been flat this long. Only used when the washer's own finish estimate is unavailable.
data_description.energy_load_jump: A single energy jump this large, with no wash phase reported, counts as a load that ran while the washer was offline.
data_description.ping_claimant_on_complete: Mention whoever claimed the load when it finishes.
data_description.availability_grace: Keep showing the last ETA for this long while the completion sensor is unavailable.
data_description.handoff_fallback: Ping whoever is next this long after a claimed load finishes if nobody taps ✅ Emptied it. 0 disables the backstop.
data_description.queue_expiry: Drop someone from the 🔜 line this long after they joined it.
data_description.show_assistant: Adds a button to the card that opens a private panel with the explainer and each person's settings.
data_description.learn_habits: Logs each Claim tap and marks a person's usual slots with ? on their own week grid. Nobody sees anyone else's guesses, and each person can opt out in the panel.
data_description.remind_dms: Lets the bot DM people unprompted: a weekly check-in and a heads-up before a booked slot. Needs day-learning on and only reaches people who chose 📬 DM me. At most 1 DM per person per day and 2 per week.
data_description.plan_dm_weekday: Day the weekly check-in is sent.
data_description.plan_dm_time: Time of day the weekly check-in is sent.
data_description.nudge_lead: How long before a booked slot starts to ask whether it is still wanted.
data_description.trades: Lets people ask each other, anonymously, to swap a booked slot. Names are revealed only if the swap is accepted.

not_loaded.message: Laundry Discord Bot is not loaded.

test_post.name: Test post
test_post.description: Posts a sample card with a working Claim button, to test the Discord connection without a real wash.

reset_session.name: Reset session
reset_session.description: Force-closes the load the bot is tracking and returns to idle. Announces nothing and pings nobody.

track_load.name: Track the running load
track_load.description: Starts tracking a wash that is running but that the bot missed, and posts a normal card. Does nothing if a load is already being tracked.

diagnostics.name: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Checks the bot's health and returns the findings. Changes nothing, so it is safe to run mid-wash.
